name: LRG-3-817 (Hubble)
blurb: LRG-3-817, a distant galaxy stretched into a long arc by a foreground galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: lrg3817-hubble
story: The gravity of a foreground galaxy cluster bends and magnifies the light of a far more distant galaxy, drawing it out into a long arc beside the cluster's center.

claims.text: LRG-3-817, also known as SDSS J090122.37+181432.3, is a galaxy stretched into an arc by a foreground cluster
ESA/Hubble image of LRG-3-817 shows a long arc beside the central galaxy cluster
The arc is a lensed background galaxy far behind a central luminous red galaxy in a cluster
